**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 01:55
- [USER] User inquired about the potential replacement of human engineers by automation and AI.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Automation and AI can reduce the need for human engineers in some areas of software quality engineering and testing, but are unlikely to completely replace them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Automation and AI are most effective when used in conjunction with human expertise and judgment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Automation can handle repetitive and time-consuming tasks but cannot replace the creativity and problem-solving skills of human engineers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Human engineers are needed to interpret results from AI-based tools and determine appropriate actions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The complexity of software systems will increase the need for human engineers.
